notes.title: Another one of my jam games is getting an Steam version
notes.notes: [p]The S3 Steam release went fairly well, so I've been considering making another updated version of a jam project. After plenty of doubts, the chosen one was "Odiumfloreo".[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3956560/Odiumfloreo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This game started out from the remarkably dumb idea of "How would a fusion of FNaF and Enviro Bear 2000" be like? I eventually got to implement this concept for a game jam, with the result being this short sit-and-survive experience in which you fend off surreal monsters by throwing physics-based objects.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534925/c4f9320e15220fb5bce7cb77f6ad347f6f87d2e4.png"][/img][/p][p]After coming back to it, I noticed the base idea was easy to expand into wacky mechanics, so I got to work on a Steam version. Whereas game jam Odiumfloreo was only 5 levels long, Steam Odiumfloreo will have 18 levels (15 of which are already finished by the time of writing this), featuring new mechanics and dangers.[/p][p]Not only that, but this new version will have brand new "point-and-click" segments between the normal levels. The original's almost non-existent plot will be expanded greatly upon, adding more surrealism, paganism, satanism and satire of the current state of the Internet.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534925/a32db8365ad6afb268a082db050472d55ab4bb31.png"][/img][/p][p][strike]I'm aiming for a Halloween release, let's hope Murphy's law doesn't show up.[/strike][/p]
